instructions: Add one confirmed row per concrete evidence item. Cite canonical source files, copy verifier excerpts verbatim, and judge source presence separately from recovery.

criteria.criterion: Use IANA Root Zone Database .museum delegation page
criteria.description: Access and use the IANA Root Zone Database delegation record for .museum (e.g., https://www.iana.org/domains/root/db/museum.html) as the information source. Full credit if the agent clearly bases the reported fields on the .museum delegation page. Full credit also if the agent attempts to access IANA but is blocked (e.g., downtime, network error, CAPTCHA) and clearly reports the blocker. Partial credit if the agent uses another credible source only after IANA is shown to be inaccessible.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 0 shows the agent is on IANA’s Root Zone Database delegation record page for .MUSEUM. Evidence includes URL `https://www.iana.org/domains/root/db/museum.html`, page title `.museum Domain Delegation Data`, and visible page heading text `Delegation Record for .MUSEUM` with the parenthetical TLD type `(Sponsored top-level domain)`. The same DOM snapshot also lists `Sponsoring Organisation` with value `Museum Domain Management Association`.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis:
EVIDENCE_STATUS: PARTIAL
The DOM explicitly supports that the source is the IANA Root Zone Database .museum delegation record page (URL and title present) and includes at least two of the requested registry fields directly in the visible content: `Delegation Record for .MUSEUM (Sponsored top-level domain)` (TLD type) and `Sponsoring Organisation` → `Museum Domain Management Association`. However, the DOM snapshot provided does not show the registry fields for `Registration date`, `WHOIS server`, or `Registration-services website`, so the agent’s claims for those items are not supported by the provided DOM evidence. Therefore, the criterion that the agent used the IANA delegation page as the information source is only partially evidenced by the DOM snapshot (it shows the correct page and some fields, but not all reported fields).
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: Agent output includes `Registration date: 2001-10-20`, `WHOIS server: whois.nic.museum`, and `Registration-services website: https://about.museum`, but DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 0 does not display any `Registration date`, `WHOIS server`, or `Registration services` fields/values. Only the page identity, TLD type `(Sponsored top-level domain)`, and `Sponsoring Organisation` value `Museum Domain Management Association` are evidenced in this DOM snapshot.

evidence_analyses.screenshot_evidence: DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 0 shows the page at URL https://www.iana.org/domains/root/db/museum.html titled ".museum Domain Delegation Data". In the visible content, it explicitly includes: "Delegation Record for .MUSEUM" and immediately after "(Sponsored top-level domain)". It also lists under the label "Sponsoring Organisation" the value "Museum Domain Management Association" (with additional address text following). No fields for "Registration date", "WHOIS server", or "Registration services" are present in this DOM snapshot segment.
evidence_analyses.criterion_analysis:
EVIDENCE_STATUS: PARTIAL
The agent’s final response claims five registry fields and asserts compliance with constraints/stopping. From the DOM evidence (State 0), only two of the five reported fields are explicitly supported as on-page facts: (1) TLD type via the text "(Sponsored top-level domain)" and (2) sponsoring organization via "Sponsoring Organisation" → "Museum Domain Management Association". However, the DOM provided does not contain any explicit evidence for the other required fields (registration date, WHOIS server, registration-services website), so we cannot confirm the agent recorded them from the delegation page or that it stopped after obtaining exactly those five fields from the page content. The action history shows only a scroll action and does not evidence restricted actions (no registration/contact), but that alone cannot fully substantiate the claimed extraction of the missing three fields.
evidence_analyses.discrepancies: The agent reported: Registration date "2001-10-20", WHOIS server "whois.nic.museum", and registration-services website "https://about.museum". DOM_MODEL_STATE_INDEX: 0 does not show any "Registration date" label/value, any "WHOIS" server entry, or any "Registration Services" website entry, so these three items are unsupported by the provided DOM evidence. No discrepancy is observed for "Sponsored top-level domain" and "Museum Domain Management Association", which do appear in the DOM snapshot.
